title: Georgia Peach at the Beach | KEY.co
description_expanded: This was our first family trip to 30A and it was incredible! The cottage - very clean and extremely well furnished. The pictures truly don’t do it justice. They have everything you need and then some. Our kids loved the bunk bed room and the front porch. The golf cart was a huge bonus for us! This house was truly a dream for a family of six. The community - obsessed with this community! Quiet and friendly. The pool was never too busy, it was heated and all of the guest were very friendly and respectful. The location is wonderful and made it extremely easy to travel to travel to nearby communities. Another plus was the easy beach access. Thank you to our wonderful host for making our first time in 30a unforgettable! Georgia Peach at the Beach in Seacrest Beach, FL, is a stunning four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom vacation home that epitomizes coastal elegance. Situated within the picturesque Magnolia Cottages by the Sea along the famed 30A, this retreat offers an array of modern conveniences, including a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar, and a master bedroom that features a private balcony and outdoor shower. The expansive screened-in porch provides a perfect spot for relaxing, while the spacious layout comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests, making it ideal for family gatherings or a getaway with friends.

Features: Outdoor seating Community pool Sun deck
Golf cart Hair dryer Cable TV
